title: Accept one tag or many
prompt: Repair `joinTags(tags: string | string[]): string`. A single string comes back unchanged. An array comes back joined with `", "` (a comma and a space). An empty array gives `""`.
hints: What does `String(["red", "blue"])` give? Compare it with `"red, blue"`.
`Array.isArray(tags)` tells you which side of the union you have.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Joins with a comma but no space.
Keeps only the first tag of an array.

feedback: What does `String(["red", "blue"])` give? Compare it with `"red, blue"`.
